kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتبحثر (form IIq)
# نَتَبَحْثَرُ (natabaḥṯaru) /na.ta.baħ.θa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَحْثَرَ (tabaḥṯara)
# نَتَبَحْثَرَ (natabaḥṯara) /na.ta.baħ.θa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَحْثَرَ (tabaḥṯara)
# نَتَبَحْثَرْ (natabaḥṯar) /na.ta.baħ.θar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَحْثَرَ (tabaḥṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
